	require.NoError(t, err)
	memoCreate := &store.Memo{

message.text: Searching for the DeleteMemo API handler to identify dependent record deletions.
Checking the API DeleteMemo handler to see if it deletes other records before the store layer.

Identifying which record types the store layer deletes before the memo row during API deletion.

In `store/memo.go`, `DeleteMemo` first removes `memo_relation` records where the memo is the source or target. Then it fetches and processes attachments linked to that memo.

The store layer then deletes each linked attachment individually. The memo row itself is removed last. Comment memos are handled by the API layer before the store layer runs.

Checking the SQLite driver's `DeleteMemo` implementation to confirm whether it also cleans up related records such as shares or reactions.

The driver only deletes the memo row itself. No other record types are removed beforehand.

The store layer deletes memo relations and attachments before removing the memo row. Comments are handled by the API layer instead.
